# 🚀 Release Checklist

- [ ] Release scope and version policy confirmed.
- [ ] Changelog reviewed.
- [ ] Source commit identified.
- [ ] GNU++17 build completed on the documented toolchain.
- [ ] Manual test evidence recorded using synthetic data.
- [ ] Documentation links and assets validated.
- [ ] Protected application files reviewed.
- [ ] No real contacts, private backups, or credentials included.
- [ ] License and third-party notices reviewed.
- [ ] Release notes identify known limitations.
- [ ] Artifact provenance and checksums recorded if binaries are published.

No release should be announced as verified until applicable checks have actual results.
